args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after deploying v2.3.1, with error rate at 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Monitoring continues.

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failed health checks, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that monitoring continues. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging, which aligns with v2.3.1 being a bad release — worth investigating before any redeploy.
